question: Does the measured angular arrangement of baryonic cluster galaxies improve RX J2129 strong-lens predictions when total mass and the radial mass profile are held fixed?

base_model.execution_correction: Before any member-layout score was evaluated, the current SciPy optimizer reproduced 3.807915 arcsec rather than the archived 3.853014 arcsec. The tolerance alone was widened to 0.1 arcsec; the expected score, physical inputs, variants, and interpretation gates were unchanged.

geometry_control.randomization: independently randomize each member position angle while retaining radius, mass, and softening
geometry_control.refit_randomization_reference: Compare the one-start randomized refits to a one-start actual-layout refit from the identical smooth-baseline parameters; retain the eight-start actual fit only as the best descriptive score. This conservative execution correction was added after the first full run exposed unequal optimizer effort.

scope: This is an ordinary baryonic member-geometry overlay, not a nonlinear two-dimensional Sigma solve.
The original heldout image set has already been inspected, so this is an exploratory spent-holdout diagnostic.
The catalog stellar masses and membership probabilities are external to the raw image-position residuals.
A positive result motivates a two-dimensional coupled Sigma solve; it does not by itself establish modified gravity.
